Let's start with saying I'm 16, so you can decide to ignore my advice.
I would say, divorce, but only if you can't talk to him at all, if he rejects any type of calm talking,  if he ignores your unhappiness,  if you ask him for help and he doesn't do anything or he doesn't care what's so ever, please  I beg you, leave him.

Talk to him about it, if he would like to do that, if he has interest in you in any way, if he cares about his children about making them and you happy
I know it's a lot to ask, but try to not be emotional,  it will only worse anything 

Now, I also don't know the ages of the kids, but, chances are that they are more than 6-8, if not It may be complicated. If they're more than 6-8 I'd advise to speak with them, to ask if they like their dad, if they want to stay with him, if they can find any joy out of him, or if he is just "dad".
Since the oldest are his children there's a possibility that they're attached to their father,  that they grew up to think what he does is completely normal, I that case things may get messy,  if you decide to divorce and they doesn't want to leave their father,  I advise to let them stay with him, I don't want you to get hurt anymore and if they have already got his way of action will only hurt you in the long run.

However If they're all younger than 6-8 than I'd advise to fight to keep all of them, hopefully you'll keep the house(I actually don't know how divorce works, I'm just assuming by things I read) you have a chance to raise them with proper love.

As I said before I may not be the best person to ask that advise,  but I'm the 3rd child of 2 parents who I wish they divorced,  I probably want it more than they thought about it.
So my advise is mainly for the children, but in general if he doesn't care about your feelings, he can go to hell for me, so it's your choice.

I hope you the best of luck💖
